tickets.title: Create local Kanban UI for ticket management
tickets.description:
## Context
Currently, tickets are managed via JSON files which is not user-friendly. We need a local web UI (like Jira/Trello).
acceptance_criteria: Kanban board with columns: backlog, todo, in_progress, review, testing, done
Drag & drop to move tickets between columns (updates JSON)
Click ticket to see details and edit

tickets.title: Add dark mode toggle
tickets.description: Add a dark mode toggle button to the Kanban UI that saves preference to localStorage.

tickets.title: Kanban UI does not display tickets
tickets.description:
The Kanban UI was created but does not properly display tickets from .forge/backlog/tickets.json.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Start server: python3 .forge/ui/server.py
2. Open http://localhost:8765
3. No tickets are visible

## Expected
Tickets should appear in their respective columns based on status.
acceptance_criteria: UI displays all tickets from tickets.json
Tickets appear in correct columns based on status
Drag and drop updates the JSON file

tickets.title: Add Product Owner agent to workflow
tickets.description:
## Context
Le workflow actuel manque de validation. Les tickets sont implémentés sans vérifier que le besoin est clair.

## Solution
Ajouter un agent Product Owner qui:
1. Raffine les tickets avant développement (backlog → todo)
2. Valide les implémentations après done
3. Crée des bug tickets si la validation échoue
acceptance_criteria: PO peut créer des bug tickets automatiquement

tickets.title: API POST /api/tickets crashes server
tickets.description:
POST requests to create tickets cause the server to crash with empty reply.

## Steps to reproduce
1. curl -X POST http://localhost:8765/api/tickets -d '{"title":"test"}'
2. Server returns empty reply (error 52)

## Expected
Ticket should be created and returned as JSON.
